_comment: Peer set for the Microsoft dashboard. Edit freely: name_match must be a lowercase substring of the SEC entityName (guards against a wrong CIK). Peers whose name does not match are skipped with a warning.

peers.name: Alphabet
peers.rationale: Google Cloud · Workspace · Gemini AI: direct rival in cloud, productivity and AI

peers.name: Amazon
peers.rationale: AWS: the other leading hyperscale public cloud

peers.name: Apple
peers.rationale: Platform and devices (OS, PC, services): mega-cap platform peer

peers.name: Meta Platforms
peers.rationale: AI infrastructure spending and open models: big-tech AI capex benchmark

peers.name: NVIDIA
peers.rationale: AI accelerators: key supplier to Azure and an AI-cycle benchmark

peers.name: Oracle
peers.rationale: OCI, databases, enterprise applications: cloud and database rival

peers.name: Salesforce
peers.rationale: CRM and enterprise SaaS: rival to Dynamics 365

peers.name: Adobe
peers.rationale: Creative and document cloud software: subscription-software benchmark

peers.name: IBM
peers.rationale: Hybrid cloud, AI and consulting: enterprise IT incumbent

peers.name: SAP
peers.rationale: ERP and enterprise software: rival to Dynamics ERP (files 20-F, reports in EUR)

peers.name: Alibaba Group
peers.rationale: Alibaba Cloud: leading cloud provider in Asia (files 20-F, reports in CNY)
